title: Model-authored arc summary (06b-A)
description: Replace the mechanical recap join in CLI rollupCampaignArc (packages/cli/src/play.ts:497-521) with a model-authored arc summary. Use deps.model: ModelClient to produce a coherent campaign-arc narrative from the campaign's accumulated session recaps. Parent: loreweaver-06b.
design:
Approach: new core module memory/arcSummary.ts mirrors memory/recapBuilder.ts placement.

API:
  composeArcSummary(model: ModelClient, input: {
    campaignId: string;
    arcId: string;
    recaps: SessionRecapRecord[];  // chronological
  }): Promise<string>

Pure read-side (no DB writes). Builds a fixed system prompt ('you write continuity primers for a future DM model') and a user message that renders each session's recap text plus a compact stateDelta listing. Throws ModelClientError on provider failure (default contract).

CLI changes in packages/cli/src/play.ts:
  - rollupCampaignArc becomes async; replaces .join(' ') with await composeArcSummary(deps.model, ...).
  - On ModelClientError (or any thrown error): write a warning via deps.io and return WITHOUT updating arc_summary. Prior arc_summary row remains; next successful close retries.
  - gracefulClose becomes async; turnLoop close path and post-quit close path become await.

Data flow:
  await gracefulClose
    -> closeSessionGracefully (transactional: scene_summary, session_recap, session close)
    -> await rollupCampaignArc
        -> listSessions -> getSessionRecap x N
        -> try { await composeArcSummary(deps.model, {recaps}) }
           catch (e) { deps.io.write('arc rollup skipped: ' + msg); return }
        -> rollupArcSummary(db, {summary, ...})   // unchanged: writes arc_summary + bible

File map:
  NEW packages/core/src/memory/arcSummary.ts
  NEW packages/core/test/arcSummary.test.ts
  MOD packages/core/src/index.ts (export composeArcSummary)
  MOD packages/cli/src/play.ts (async rollupCampaignArc, async gracefulClose, error handling)
  MOD packages/cli/test/play.test.ts (fake model handles arc-summary call; failure-mode test)

Tradeoffs:
  - Caller-composes pattern (CLI calls composeArcSummary before rollupArcSummary) mirrors composeSessionRecap. Rejected alternative: threading ModelClient through closeSessionGracefully — mixes transactional DB writes with network I/O.
  - Caller-composes also makes errors recoverable at the CLI boundary without unwinding the close transaction.

Prompt content: drafted in implementation, tuned via test snapshot. Continuity-primer framing, ~300-500 words target, second person present tense.

Open follow-ups: bible extraction (06b-B = loreweaver-5ze), multi-arc (06b-C = loreweaver-x63) are separate beads.
acceptance_criteria:
1. composeArcSummary exists in @loreweaver/core and resolves with the model-authored string from a SessionRecapRecord[] plus a ModelClient.
2. CLI rollupCampaignArc uses composeArcSummary; the mechanical .join(' ') is removed.
3. On model error during the close arc rollup, gracefulClose still completes: session closed, session_recap written, prior arc_summary row untouched, warning written to deps.io.
4. composeArcSummary unit tests cover: happy path; ModelClientError propagation.
5. CLI play.test.ts is updated: fake model handles the arc-summary call; a failure-mode test exercises the model-error skip path.
6. npm run typecheck and npm run test (vitest run) both succeed.
